correctness.rationale: Exact cosine/sine Brownian Fourier kernels integrated over a cycle yield H_d and K_d. Regenerative reward covariance under E[T^3]<infinity yields both effective diffusivities with the correct 1/(2 E T) normalization and the centered time-displacement covariance. H_d double derivative is (4/3)(e^-dt-e^-4dt)>0. Strict Jensen gives the unique deterministic minimum; pointwise H_d(t)<t/d gives unattained supremum; two positive finite-support protocols prove sharpness and unbounded longitudinal diffusivity. Deterministic difference factors as -(v^2/(12 mu d^2))(1-e^-dmu)^3(3+e^-dmu). The independent checker verifies 1626 assertion groups and agrees with published Poisson diffusion coefficients. Diagnostics are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: With only average reorientation frequency fixed, it is physically meaningful to bound lateral spread of a directed swimmer. The sharp, fully attainable transverse interval and unique periodic minimum provide exact protocol-design guidance. More surprisingly, two reset protocols with identical mean interval can have opposite transport-anisotropy signs and arbitrarily different longitudinal dispersion while transverse dispersion remains bounded and near its minimum. This is more than a numerical parameter substitution or a marginal moment recomputation.
